concerns.text: The E2E test in verify_feature.py relies on arbitrary wait_for_timeout(500) calls, which can cause flakiness on slower environments. Prefer using Playwright's auto-waiting or explicit locator assertions.
Name mapping via loginUsername.includes('иван') to assign fullName in frontend component logic is fragile and prone to false positives.

Document edit changes version manually via `version: doc.version + 1`. While fine for frontend local storage emulation, this must be handled on the backend via pessimistic or optimistic database lock controls in production.
